name: margin-sidebar
description: A free, open-source sidebar that lives in the margin of every browser: hover the edge for your apps, AI, bookmark stacks and search.

scripts.safari: npm run build:safari && xcrun safari-web-extension-converter dist/safari --project-location safari-xcode --app-name Margin --bundle-identifier org.margin-sidebar.Margin --macos-only --no-prompt --force
